title: Java: from the first compile to reliable applications
summary: 36 lessons in Java, from first programs and objects to collections, concurrency, testing and practical services. Worked examples and separate solutions connect language rules with observable behavior.

lessons.title: From source file to running JVM
lessons.outcome: A Java program begins as text.
lessons.lab: Create a message variable containing Hello, Java and print it once.
lessons.verification: one line Hello, Java. compiler result false and at least one ERROR diagnostic.

lessons.title: Values, numeric types and conversion
lessons.outcome: A numeric type defines both a range and a set of operations.
lessons.lab: Calculate integer division `7 / 2` and floating-point division `7 / 2.0`.
lessons.verification: integer 3 and double 3.5. exact division throws; rounded result 0.33.

lessons.title: Decisions, loops and invariants
lessons.outcome: Control flow chooses which statements run and how often.
lessons.lab: Use text null and test text!=null before calling isEmpty.
lessons.verification: condition false with no NullPointerException. wrong loop raises ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

lessons.title: Methods and explicit contracts
lessons.outcome: A method packages a computation behind a contract: which inputs it accepts, what it returns, what state it changes and how it reports invalid input.
lessons.lab: Implement doubleValue(int x) and evaluate 7 and 0.
lessons.verification: 14 and 0. int and long respectively.

lessons.title: Arrays, strings and Unicode
lessons.outcome: An array is a fixed-length indexed container.
lessons.lab: Copy array 1,2,3,mutate the copy and compare the original.
lessons.verification: original starts 1; copy starts 9. ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

lessons.title: Lists, sets and maps
lessons.outcome: Lists preserve an ordered sequence and may contain duplicates.
lessons.lab: Create a mutable list red,blue,red and append green.
lessons.verification: size 4; red appears twice. UnsupportedOperationException.

lessons.title: Classes and encapsulation
lessons.outcome: An object combines state with operations that preserve its rules.
lessons.lab: Construct accounts with 100 and 100 cents,deposit 50 into the first.
lessons.verification: balances 150 and 100. ArithmeticException;original maximum balance preserved.

lessons.title: Constructors, records and invariants
lessons.outcome: A record is a concise carrier for a fixed set of components, with generated accessors, equality, hashing and a descriptive string.
lessons.lab: Create an Order with ID " A " and item x.
lessons.verification: ID A and items[x]. NullPointerException from the declared copy policy.

lessons.title: Exceptions and resource lifetime
lessons.outcome: Exceptions separate normal return values from failure.
lessons.lab: Open a Probe resource, record body, then inspect closure order.
lessons.verification: events body, close A. cause remains the original IOException.

lessons.title: Interfaces and polymorphism
lessons.outcome: An interface describes behavior a caller can rely on without depending on one implementation.
lessons.lab: Use Pricing references to identity and half-price implementations on 100 cents.
lessons.verification: 100 and 50. negative fee IllegalArgumentException;null delegate NullPointerException.

lessons.title: Equality, hashing and ordering
lessons.outcome: Equality, hashing and ordering are related contracts with different roles.
lessons.lab: Create two equal Point records and insert one into a map.
lessons.verification: lookup with the other returns origin; hashes equal. display labels equal; points unequal.

lessons.title: Generics and variance
lessons.outcome: Generics express type relationships so many errors can be detected before execution.
lessons.lab: Sum `List.of(1, 2, 3)` and `List.of(1.5, 2.5)` through List<?extends Number>.
lessons.verification: sums 6.0 and 4.0. runtime classes equal; compile-time contracts remain distinct.

lessons.title: Lambdas and functional interfaces
lessons.outcome: A lambda supplies the behavior of a functional interface, an interface with one abstract method.
lessons.lab: Create a Predicate<Integer> accepting positive values and test 3,0,-1.
lessons.verification: true, false, false. 7 accepted; blank rejected.

lessons.title: Streams and collectors
lessons.outcome: A stream is a single-use computation pipeline over a source.
lessons.lab: Keep even values from 1,2,3,4 and sum their squares.
lessons.verification: 20. 5 versus 9; parallel sum 5050.

lessons.title: Dates, time zones and formatting
lessons.outcome: Time has several meanings.
lessons.lab: Parse `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z` and view it in UTC and America/New_York.
lessons.verification: same instant; New York local date 2023-12-31. start included; end excluded.

lessons.title: Files, paths and character encoding
lessons.outcome: A path names a location; it is not the file contents or a guarantee that the location exists.
lessons.lab: Write Café and an emoji to an owned temporary file,then read it with UTF-8.
lessons.verification: exact text equality. original exception propagated; owned directory absent.

lessons.title: Optional values and validation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Optional represents the presence or absence of a value in a return contract.
lessons.lab: Look up known a and unknown b in a fixed map through Optional.
lessons.verification: a present with 7; b empty. specific absence failure.

lessons.title: Tests that detect broken behavior
lessons.outcome: A useful test distinguishes correct behavior from a plausible mistake.
lessons.lab: Test clamp for values -2,0,3,9 under bounds 0..5.
lessons.verification: outputs 0,0,3,5. all originals restored; input arrays unchanged.

lessons.title: Data structures and complexity
lessons.outcome: A data structure is a set of operations with representation and cost tradeoffs.
lessons.lab: Add a,b,c to an ArrayDeque and remove from the front.
lessons.verification: a,b,c order. poll returns null; remove throws NoSuchElementException.

lessons.title: Search, sorting and dynamic programming
lessons.outcome: Algorithms connect a problem contract to a sequence of operations and invariants.
lessons.lab: Run lowerBound on 1,2,2,5 with target 2 and target 6.
lessons.verification: indices 1 and 4. IllegalArgumentException for both.

lessons.title: Threads and the memory model
lessons.outcome: Threads can execute concurrently while sharing memory.
lessons.lab: Start a worker that writes 42 into a shared holder, join it with a bound, and inspect the result.
lessons.verification: worker terminated; result 42. interruption observed and worker terminated.

lessons.title: Executors, futures and cancellation
lessons.outcome: An ExecutorService owns task scheduling and worker lifetime.
lessons.lab: Submit a callable returning 42 and get it within 2 seconds.
lessons.verification: result 42. third submission rejected; admitted tasks finish after release.

lessons.title: Locks, atomics and concurrent collections
lessons.outcome: Synchronization protects a state transition,not merely a variable name.
lessons.lab: Run two workers making 1000 synchronized increments each.
lessons.verification: counter 2000. 2000 increments and no blocked worker after bounded joins.

lessons.title: Virtual threads and blocking work
lessons.outcome: Virtual threads are lightweight Java threads intended to make large numbers of blocking tasks easier to express.
lessons.lab: Start a virtual thread that records isVirtual and join it.
lessons.verification: true and terminated. caller can acquire the monitor while the worker is waiting.

lessons.title: JVM memory, GC and allocation
lessons.outcome: The JVM manages heap memory through reachability,not by immediately freeing an object when a local variable changes.
lessons.lab: Store a small byte array in a list and drop the local variable reference.
lessons.verification: list still exposes the same array contents. nonnegative counters; max at least total; no claim of exact object size.

lessons.title: Packages, classpaths and modules
lessons.outcome: Packages organize class names and access boundaries.
lessons.lab: Read `String.class` module and package names.
lessons.verification: module `java.base`;package `java.lang`. nonzero compiler exit and captured diagnostic.

lessons.title: Builds and dependency reproducibility
lessons.outcome: A build turns source and declared dependencies into an artifact.
lessons.lab: Build a Hello class whose main prints build-ok.
lessons.verification: compiler exit 0;Hello.class exists. exact version accepted; LATEST not treated as a pin.

lessons.title: HTTP services and clients
lessons.outcome: HTTP is a request/response protocol with method,path,status,headers and body.
lessons.lab: Start the fixture and request `GET /health`.
lessons.verification: status 200 and body ok. host 127.0.0.1;port positive; closed flag true.

lessons.title: JDBC and transactions
lessons.outcome: JDBC is Java's database-access API.
lessons.lab: Open the fixture,inspect product metadata and count the two account rows.
lessons.verification: database product H2; 2 rows; auto-commit initially true. second session sees 100 before commit and 95 after commit.

lessons.title: Serialization and schema evolution
lessons.outcome: Serialization turns domain values into a representation that another process or version can read.
lessons.lab: Encode account a1, balance 125, note Café with version 2 and decode.
lessons.verification: equal domain record and exact Unicode note. trailing payload IOException; negative balance IllegalArgumentException.

lessons.title: Reflection, annotations and service loading
lessons.outcome: Reflection inspects or invokes program elements through metadata rather than ordinary compile-time calls.
lessons.lab: Read Version on the known Friendly provider.
lessons.verification: version 2. version 2 accepted;version 3 rejected.

lessons.title: Profiling and benchmark reasoning
lessons.outcome: Performance measurement starts with a correct,representative workload.
lessons.lab: Sum 1..1000 with a loop and compare with n*(n+1)/2.
lessons.verification: 500500. metadata names 100 warmups and profiling false; universal claim false.

lessons.title: Secure application boundaries
lessons.outcome: An application boundary converts untrusted input into a limited set of permitted operations.
lessons.lab: Create `input.txt` inside an owned root and read at most 10 bytes.
lessons.verification: content hello. diagnostic excludes both sensitive fields.

lessons.title: Application design and dependency boundaries
lessons.outcome: Application design separates domain decisions from the mechanisms that supply data,time or side effects.
lessons.lab: Compute 3 items at 125 cents and check the zero/negative quantity policy.
lessons.verification: 375 cents; nonpositive quantity rejected. ArithmeticException;audit sink unused.

lessons.title: Build a tested local data service
lessons.outcome: A small data service combines domain rules, storage and transport contracts.
lessons.lab: Summarize group A over amounts 10,20 and group B over 5.
lessons.verification: A count 2, total 30; B count 1, total 5. 3 unchanged records; closed flag true.

lessons.title: Package, diagnose and maintain a release
lessons.outcome: A release is a reproducible artifact plus evidence about how it starts,what contracts it accepts and how failures are diagnosed.
lessons.lab: Compile the fixture with --release 21 and inspect its class header.
lessons.verification: magic CAFEBABE; major version 65. previous artifact v1 retained; custom_runtime_built False.
